items.title: Russian missiles and drone reportedly hit Poland during attacks on Ukraine
items.summary:
Polish PM calls strikes, which took place amid western military exercises, ‘an intentional provocation’ by Moscow

Two Russian cruise missiles and a jet-powered drone are reported to have crashed in Poland during Russian air attacks on Ukraine that took place amid major western military exercises by allied countries.

Ukraine’s president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, said it was “one of the largest attacks” since the full-scale Russian invasion in 2022, with at least eight people killed and nearly 30 injured in Ukraine.

items.title: Outcry as fossil fuels scrubbed from draft UN climate deal
items.summary: UN climate talks co-host Australia unveiled a new draft agreement Thursday that drops any mention of fossil fuels, the leading driver of global warming, sparking anger from campaign groups. The nearly 200 nations involved in the COP31 global climate talks in Turkey have until Friday to strike a final agreement, though the marathon negotiations often run into overtime. The summit is unfolding against a record-breaking El Nino, disasters fuelled by climate change from Europe to Nepal and a global energy shock triggered by the Iran war.

items.title: China, Russia and US agree peace declaration with no mention of Ukraine and Iran wars
items.summary:
Xi, Putin and Trump outline priorities that include UN reform, boosting oil supplies and ‘protection of diplomatic immunity’

China, Russia and the US say they have agreed a peace statement after an unprecedented trilateral summit, but the declaration made no mention of the wars in Ukraine and Iran caused by two of the participants.

The declaration on Thursday also outlined a set of priorities that included changing the UN, boosting oil supplies and what it said was the protection of diplomatic immunity.

items.title: Russia pummels Ukraine with massive strikes, missile hits Poland
items.summary: Moscow pounded Ukraine with massive strikes Friday, with Kyiv saying at least six people were killed in the capital, and neighbouring Poland reporting two Russian missiles likely landed in the south-east corner of the NATO country, accusing Moscow of a "provocation." Hours earlier, Russia's Vladimir Putin vowed a "painful" response to Kyiv's strikes on Moscow's Crimea bridge after holding a summit with China's Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump. FRANCE 24's Gulliver Cragg reports from Kyiv, Ukraine.

items.title: Italy strike draws workers, students into nationwide protests over wages and living costs
items.summary: A nationwide strike was expected to disrupt schools, hospitals and local transport across Italy on Friday as workers and students began marching in dozens of cities to demand higher wages, lower living costs and greater social protections. The labor action coincided with an International Day of Student Mobilisation, with organisers planning demonstrations in more than 45 Italian cities. FRANCE 24's Seema Gupta reports from Rome, Italy.

items.title: Iraqi forces strike compromise with powerful pro-Iran militia
items.summary: Iraq has reached ​a compromise with the powerful Iran-backed militia Kataib Hezbollah, three senior security officials said, after Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi readied security forces to move against the group. Iraqi officials had accused the group of running a smuggling ring that siphoned off hundreds of millions ​of dollars' worth of ‌state-owned oil. Under the deal brokered by senior Shi'ite political leaders to avert a confrontation, government ⁠forces were expected to move into the group's stronghold of Jurf al-Sakhar on Friday.

items.title: COP31 wrapping up in Turkey: Climate deal elusive as fossil fuels go unmentioned
items.summary: The UN's COP31 climate talks were set to spill into overtime Friday as countries remained deadlocked over a draft deal that makes no mention of fossil fuels, with a host of other disputes also snarling negotiations. The talks come with a series of stark reminders of the urgency of climate action, from heatwaves in Europe and devastating floods in Nepal, while a record-breaking El Nino supercharges temperatures.
